_meta.doc: Rated entry id → the jersey number he wore most often on that franchise in that decade (nflverse rosters; else that decade on any team; else his Wikipedia infobox number, per franchise when it maps; else his most-worn number in any decade). Missing = no number anywhere (the game assigns a position-typical one and marks it estimated).
